title: The Charge Retained on a Granite Ridge Season Pass and the Share Taken Off the Credit Issued
content:
Where the charge retained on a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass being given up stands on the pass account, a share of it is taken off the amount coming back.

**First.** Where that charge stands on the pass account and the account still shows an amount to collect, the whole of it is taken off, a share of 100 per cent.

**Second.** Where that charge stands on the pass account and the account shows nothing left to collect, half of it is taken off, a share of 50 per cent.

**Otherwise.** In any other case none of it is taken off by this rule.

### The two conditions

| The charge retained on the pass being given up | The amount the pass account still shows to collect | Share taken off |
| --- | --- | --- |
| standing on the pass account | above nothing | 100 per cent |
| standing on the pass account | nothing left to collect | 50 per cent |
| not standing on the pass account | either | none by this rule |

The figure this rule reads is the charge retained on the pass being given up as it stands on that pass account; where no such charge stands there, neither condition is reached.

### Worked on a hypothetical account

A pass account carrying a retained charge of 187.50 and still showing 640.00 to collect. The whole 187.50 is taken off the amount coming back. On the same account showing nothing left to collect, half of 187.50 is taken off, which is 93.75.
